extracted.intended_audience: general news readers interested in corporate PR, diversity issues, and consumer-brand controversies
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and implicit criteria for how a consumer brand should respond publicly after an ad-driven racism controversy — e.g., statements, apologies, product removals, and organizational changes. Useful for drafting press releases or public statements in similar crises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appoint a dedicated diversity and inclusiveness leader
rubrics_metrics.description: H&M ... said Global Manager for Employee Relations Annie Wu, a company veteran, would be the new global leader for diversity and inclusiveness. Facebook: 'we have appointed a global leader, in this area, to drive our work forward.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate concrete organizational action by naming a senior role or leader to oversee diversity work; present the appointment as a mechanism to 'drive our work forward' and show commitment beyond statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue an explicit public apology acknowledging the mistake
rubrics_metrics.description: H&M apologized ... 'we have got this wrong and we agree that, even if unintentional, passive or casual racism needs to be eradicated wherever it exists.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apologies should be direct and acknowledge the wrongdoing; avoid vague language. Explicitly name the harm (e.g., racism) and commit to eradication or correction in clear terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove offending content and product from circulation
rubrics_metrics.description: The fashion brand took down the ad and said the hoodie worn in it will be removed from sale and recycled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Immediate, visible remedial actions (take down ads, pull products, remove listings, recycle/destroy inventory) are expected and should be communicated publicly as part of the response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge intent while accepting responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The Stockholm-based company reiterated ... 'the recent incident was entirely unintentional' but 'demonstrates so clearly how big our responsibility is as a global brand.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the action was unintentional, state that fact but pair it with acceptance of responsibility and recognition of impact; do not use 'unintentional' to deflect accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the same platforms/channels to communicate corrective measures
rubrics_metrics.description: H&M first announced the appointment Tuesday on its Facebook page. In an email to The Associated Press ... the retailer said ... would be the new global leader.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publish corrective statements on the platforms where the incident appeared or where the audience is engaged (e.g., the social channel that hosted the ad) and through mainstream media channels to reach wider audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate awareness of cultural differences and global sensitivities
rubrics_metrics.description: The case highlights how important it has become for multinationals to take into account differences in cultural views and sensitivities between the markets it sells in.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should show understanding of varied cultural perspectives, and companies should implement review processes sensitive to global audiences to prevent future missteps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond promptly and visibly to stakeholder backlash
rubrics_metrics.description: NBA star LeBron James and rapper Diddy were among those who had responded with outrage ... The Weeknd and G-Eazy cancelled partnerships ... In South Africa, there were protests at some H&M stores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely responses (apologies, product removal, statements of action) are important; acknowledge and address reactions from influencers, partners, customers, and protesters, and manage partnership fallout proactively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make public commitments that indicate longer-term change, not only one-off fixes
rubrics_metrics.description: Facebook: 'our commitment to addressing diversity and inclusiveness is genuine, therefore we have appointed a global leader, in this area, to drive our work forward.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame actions as part of ongoing work (e.g., appointing leaders, creating programs or audits) so the public perceives sustained change rather than a temporary gesture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be transparent about actions and follow-up
rubrics_metrics.description: The retailer said on Facebook ... the recent incident was entirely unintentional ... and reiterated steps taken (apology, ad removal, product removal/recycling).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear, specific information about what was done, who was assigned responsibility, and next steps; transparency builds trust and counters speculation.
